report.summary: The 2026-02-24 AUDIT.md backlog has been substantially executed: 22 of 30 findings are verifiably resolved at HEAD, including both criticals (C1 header duplication now pure forwarding headers; C2 fixed with PIC_RunQueue/CPU_Check_NMI in cpu_bridge.cpp:113,119) and 7 of 9 highs (H1 V5 GPR/RAM/VGA serialization, H5 strict handle matching, H6 subtraction-form bounds, H8 real framebuffer sync, H9, plus M1-M3, M6-M9, M11 and 6 of 8 lows). Verified-open remainders are H2 (dual thread-local contexts), H3/M10 (deprecated stub step path), H4/M5 (accepted-design init stubs), H7 (HashMode::Full still missing VGA/device hashing vs header contract), M4, L1 (README now documents only 23 of 50 APIs), and L3. The paper trail itself is the new weak point: ROADMAP.md and roadmap.md are both tracked as case-colliding paths and the March source-verified ROADMAP (commit 8e3b0b0) was clobbered back to a stale-stamped 4,061-line document in June (1dd76b4); TODO.md is 3.5 months stale and internally contradictory; CHANGELOG.md claims TLS verification that does not exist in code; and AUDIT.md records none of the 22 resolutions. Roadmap gaps confirmed at HEAD: Security Hardening ~6-10/22 REQs still open (TLS, mount confinement, signing), GPL isolation mostly built but with 6 proxy NOT_SUPPORTED parity gaps and a stub protocol.cpp, Wasm Sandbox 0/50 (CMake option only), UX ~2-3/11.

findings.title: Dual g_current_context thread-locals (aibox + dosbox layers) still unmerged
findings.evidence: Both `thread_local MachineContext* g_current_context` (machine_context.cpp:20) and `thread_local dosbox::DOSBoxContext* g_current_context` (dosbox_context.cpp:65) still exist at HEAD; TODO.md Engine-Level Technical Debt still lists 'Eliminate thread-local current_context() accessors' as open. Mitigated by ContextGuard dual-set during step scope only.
findings.recommendation: Either unify the two context types behind one TLS accessor or formally document the dual-guard invariant (every cross-layer entry point must set both) and add a debug assertion that they refer to the same logical instance.

findings.title: Deprecated stub execution path dosbox_step()/MachineContext::step() still compiled and exported
findings.evidence: dosbox_context.cpp:973-976 comment: 'DEPRECATED(M10): Routes through MachineContext::step() which is a counter-incrementing stub... Only called from test_dosbox_context.cpp. Will be removed in a future pass.' machine_context.cpp:229: 'No real CPU execution — counter increment only'. Covers prior H3 as well; REQ-LC-005 (no alternative stub path) remains a GAP.
findings.recommendation: Delete dosbox_step() and the MachineContext::step() counter body, migrate test_dosbox_context.cpp to dosbox_lib_step_cycles(), closing H3, M10 and REQ-LC-005 in one pass.

findings.title: HashMode::Full still omits VGA and device state while header contract promises them
findings.evidence: state_hash.cpp:300-303 now hashes conventional memory (builder.update(ctx->memory.base, ctx->memory.size)) but comments 'VGA and device state will be added in Phase B'; state_hash.h:40-47 still documents Full mode as 'all of fast mode plus memory, VGA state, device state'. Narrowed since 2026-02 (memory added) but contract still overstated — notable because V5 serialization (faababd) now captures VGA registers, so the hash could reuse that path.
findings.recommendation: Feed EngineStateVgaRegisters + VRAM (already serialized in V5) into the Full-mode hash, or amend the header docs to state the actual coverage until then.

findings.title: MachineContext init_* stubs and 7 undefined forward-declared classes retained as accepted design
findings.evidence: machine_context.cpp:376-378: '// H4/M5: These init stubs delegate to DOSBox-X engine bridge... intentional no-ops'; all 7 init_* methods (lines 380-419) still return Ok() immediately. machine_context.h:34-40 still forward-declares VgaContext, DosKernel, PicController, PitTimer, KeyboardController, MouseController, SoundSubsystem with no definitions anywhere (covers prior M5).
findings.recommendation: Delete the dead init_* interface and the 7 phantom forward declarations (initialization is owned by the engine bridge), or mark them permanently in the header so future audits stop re-flagging.

findings.title: README documents only 23 of 50 public C API functions
findings.evidence: legends_embed.h declares 50 distinct legends_* functions (grep -oE 'legends_[a-z0-9_]+\(' | sort -u = 50); README.md mentions only ~31 distinct legends_ identifiers and 27 of the 50 functions do not appear at all. Gap widened since the prior audit (was ~18 of 22) because the API more than doubled.
findings.recommendation: Generate the README API table from legends_embed.h Doxygen annotations (6,451 annotations already exist per AUDIT_REPORT) and add a CI doc-coverage check.

findings.title: HandleRegistry remains fully implemented but dead in production
findings.evidence: Only consumers at HEAD are tests (test_handle_registry.cpp, test_gsl_contracts.cpp, test_thread_safety.cpp); zero references in src/legends/legends_embed_api.cpp, which uses strict pointer comparison via get_instance() (legends_embed_api.cpp:79-82) instead.
findings.recommendation: Delete HandleRegistry and its tests, or adopt it as the multi-instance handle mechanism if the single-instance constraint is ever lifted; do not keep maintaining dead code.

findings.title: Engine-header mutable extern globals only partially tracked in migration registry
findings.evidence: globals_registry.yaml grew to 70 tracked entries (includes CPU_Cycles/CPU_CycleLeft at lines 36/49), but engine headers still expose unregistered mutable externs: cpu.h has 26 extern declarations, bios.h 19, callback.h 4. Narrowed since prior audit, not closed.
findings.recommendation: Run a one-time sweep of engine/include extern declarations into the registry with status=deferred where appropriate, and extend sprint2-checks.yml to fail on new untracked externs.

findings.title: ROADMAP.md and roadmap.md both tracked (case collision); March source-verified roadmap clobbered with stale-stamped content
findings.evidence: git ls-files shows BOTH ROADMAP.md and roadmap.md tracked at HEAD with identical 209,189-byte blobs. Commit 8e3b0b0 (2026-03-15) deleted the 4,061-line roadmap.md and created a 427-line source-verified ROADMAP.md 'correcting major factual errors' (API 50 not 22, save format V3 not V4, REQ-SEC-024 not implemented, GPL IPC partially implemented); commit 1dd76b4 (2026-06-08) re-expanded it +3,994/-360 lines back to a 4,061-line document whose own changelog still says 'v4.1.0 (2026-02-25)' (roadmap.md:3845-3847). On Windows (the primary dev OS) case-colliding tracked paths cause nondeterministic checkout clobbering — the likely mechanism of the loss.
findings.recommendation: git rm one of the two case-colliding paths, reconcile content against the March source-verified version, update the internal version stamp, and add a CI guard rejecting case-only-duplicate tracked filenames.

findings.title: CHANGELOG.md claims TLS verification but no HTTP/TLS transport exists (REQ-SEC-005 open)
findings.evidence: CHANGELOG.md:36-38 lists 'Security hardening: TLS verification, API key protection, config field limits...' under Added. ai_http_client.cpp:212 is the only transport-related line: '// Actual thread creation deferred to application wiring (libcurl optional).' — no TLS/SSL/curl/WinHttp code exists in the AI client. AUDIT_REPORT.md (2026-03-20) section 4 flagged the identical gap; it remains unfixed at HEAD while the user-facing changelog asserts the opposite.
findings.recommendation: Reword CHANGELOG and roadmap REQ-SEC-005 status to planned/deferred immediately (S), and schedule the actual libcurl-with-cert-verification wiring before any release that ships the AI panel (M).

findings.title: TODO.md is 3.5 months stale and internally contradictory (same REQs marked both done and missing)
findings.evidence: TODO.md:3 last updated 2026-02-27. Line 19 claims 'GPL v2 Process Isolation: STUB 2/16' while src/legends_ipc/, src/engine_host/, src/legends_proxy/ are substantially built with a Linux IPC CI lane (commits 8e46c2d, 0de44cd, 3e73565); AUDIT_REPORT.md measured 12-13/16. Internal contradiction: line 90 marks REQ-MOUNT-001 complete ('[x] Host directory mounting (mount_manager.cpp, legends_mount_drive API)') while line 168 lists the same REQ-MOUNT-001 under 'Not Yet Implemented — Must-Have (Release Blockers)'; same dual listing for REQ-MOUNT-002, REQ-MENU-001, REQ-MAPPER-001, REQ-SAVE-003, REQ-CAPTURE-003.
findings.recommendation: Regenerate TODO.md from the verification matrix or retire it in favor of the single reconciled ROADMAP; stale planning docs are actively misleading sprint planning.

findings.title: IPC protocol.cpp still a stub and 6 proxy APIs return NOT_SUPPORTED, contradicting 'GPL isolation mostly complete' record
findings.evidence: protocol.cpp:1 reads '// Stub — not yet implemented'. proxy_api.cpp returns LEGENDS_ERR_NOT_SUPPORTED in IPC mode for video capture start/stop/query (:452-454), legends_set_ttf_font (:571), legends_register_event_callback (:675), plus :425. CIFix.md (2026-06-08) confirms 'several proxy C ABI functions still return LEGENDS_ERR_NOT_SUPPORTED'. roadmap.md §14 says 'MOSTLY COMPLETE' and CHANGELOG claims a full 'IPC protocol' — embedders using IPC mode for GPL compliance silently lose these features.
findings.recommendation: Close the 6 proxy parity gaps (the engine_host dispatcher already exists), implement or delete protocol.cpp, and publish an IPC-mode capability matrix in legends_embed.h docs; GPL isolation is the license-compliance load-bearing wall (RISK-019 High/Critical).

findings.title: AUDIT.md records none of the 22 resolved findings, inviting duplicate remediation
findings.evidence: AUDIT.md still presents all 30 findings as current ('Top Findings by Severity', EARS table showing 24 GAP of 50 REQs) although 22 are fixed — several fixes carry code comments citing the finding IDs (cpu_bridge.cpp:113 'C2 fix', dosbox_library.cpp:118 '(M8)', :382 '(M9)', dosbox_context.cpp:973 'DEPRECATED(M10)'). The March AUDIT_REPORT.md does not cross-reference the February IDs, so no document records the true open set (verified here: H2, H3/M10, H4/M5, H7, M4, L1, L3).
findings.recommendation: Append a verified-2026-06-09 disposition table to AUDIT.md (this report's section 3/6 supplies it) or formally supersede AUDIT.md with the audit-wiki as the system of record.

sprint_recommendations: Documentation-of-record reconciliation sprint (S-M): remove the ROADMAP.md/roadmap.md case collision and restore the source-verified roadmap, regenerate TODO.md from the verification matrix, annotate AUDIT.md with the 22 verified resolutions, fix the false TLS claim in CHANGELOG.md, and add a CI guard for case-colliding tracked paths.

Security Hardening completion sprint (M-L): implement or honestly re-label REQ-SEC-005 (TLS transport for the AI client), finish REQ-SEC-023/024 (canonical path resolution, read-only mount enforcement — flag exists, no logic), REQ-SEC-031 threat-model doc, and REQ-SEC-035/036 (code signing + checksum publication) to make gate G5 passable.

GPL process-isolation parity sprint (M): close the 6 proxy NOT_SUPPORTED gaps (video capture x3, TTF font, event callbacks), implement or delete the stub protocol.cpp, add IPC reconnection handling, and publish an IPC-mode capability matrix — this is the GPL-compliance load-bearing wall (RISK-019 High/Critical).

Engine-debt and contract-truth sprint (M): delete the deprecated dosbox_step()/MachineContext::step() counter path (H3/M10) and the dead init_*/forward-decl interface (H4/M5), wire VGA+device state into HashMode::Full or fix its header contract (H7), regenerate README API docs for all 50 functions (L1), and delete-or-adopt HandleRegistry (L3); also decide Wasm Sandbox (0/50 unchanged since Feb): fund a REQ-WASM-001..010 spike or formally defer Section 15 so completion metrics stop being distorted.

report.summary: The in-process C ABI (50 legends_* functions in include/legends/legends_embed.h) has improved markedly since the 2026-02-24 audit: the destroy-fallback hole (H5), unused error codes (L2), LEGENDS_ERROR macro collision (L4), and the 27-pair header duplication (C1) are all verifiably fixed at HEAD, and config strings are now deep-copied. The new risk center is the IPC/runtime split added since February: the GPL-isolation mode cannot actually run end-to-end (no production code ever establishes the ProxyConnection; SDL2+IPC cannot even link; the CI IPC job builds headless-only so neither is caught), the two runtimes diverge semantically on at least six functions plus destroy/null-handle/capture_rgb contracts, the ABI version handshake is transmitted but never validated across the process boundary, and the installed package ships 25 forwarding headers plus runtime_host.h that cannot compile or link for an external consumer. A build-from-source, single-instance, in-process embedder gets a genuinely good C API today; the README/architecture promises beyond that (process isolation, installable SDK, multi-instance motivation) are not yet delivered.

findings.title: IPC runtime mode is not usable end-to-end: no connection bootstrap, SDL2+IPC cannot link, CI never exercises the app
findings.evidence: Every proxied API gates on conn().is_connected() returning LEGENDS_ERR_NOT_INITIALIZED; ProxyConnection::connect() lives in a private header and is called only from tests (repo grep: zero references in src/app or src/main.cpp; EngineSpawner used only in crash_handler.cpp:35 for restart). So in IPC builds Application::init's legends_create() (application.cpp:905) always fails with EngineCreateFailed. Additionally SDL2+IPC project_legends compiles only src/main.cpp and links legends_proxy+legends_pal but not legends_app (CMakeLists.txt:1173-1180), while main.cpp:9 instantiates legends::Application compiled only into legends_app (CMakeLists.txt:503-505) — guaranteed link failure. The linux-ipc CI job uses -DLEGENDS_HEADLESS=ON so project_legends is never built (ci.yml:108-127).
findings.recommendation: Implement spawn+connect bootstrap inside proxy legends_create (EngineSpawner + pipe/SHM + handshake) or expose a public connect API; split Application out of GPL-linked legends_app so SDL2+IPC links; add a CI job that boots the app or a smoke embedder against a spawned engine host.

findings.title: In-process and IPC runtimes do not expose identical C ABI semantics (NOT_SUPPORTED gaps, destroy(NULL) inversion, inconsistent handle validation, capture_rgb contract change)
findings.evidence: Six functions return LEGENDS_ERR_NOT_SUPPORTED over IPC (set_log_callback proxy_api.cpp:424-426, video capture trio :452-454, set_ttf_font :571, register_event_callback :675) while the app calls runtime_->set_log_callback unconditionally (application.cpp:1181,1193). legends_destroy(NULL) is a documented no-op in-process (legends_embed_api.cpp:960-963) but the proxy ignores the handle and always sends DestroyReq, destroying the engine singleton (proxy_api.cpp:81-83, engine_dispatcher.cpp:67-73). ~15 proxy functions skip null-handle validation while ~20 others check it. Proxy capture_rgb returns LEGENDS_OK without copying when the buffer is too small and OK with size 0 when no frame exists, vs in-process BUFFER_TOO_SMALL semantics (legends_embed_api.cpp:1313-1319). WRONG_THREAD/REENTRANT_CALL guards are unreachable for IPC embedders.
findings.recommendation: Build one parameterized C-ABI conformance suite run against both runtimes in CI; fix proxy null-handle checks, destroy(NULL), and capture_rgb error contract; implement log/event forwarding over the already-reserved SetLogCallbackReq/EventNotification messages or formally gate via legends_has_capability.

findings.title: ABI version handshake and config do not survive the IPC boundary (versions transmitted but never validated; config_path silently dropped)
findings.evidence: CreateReq carries only 7 numeric fields — api_version, struct_size, config_path, working_dir are dropped (messages.h:112-128, proxy_api.cpp:59-68); the dispatcher rebuilds the config from its own LEGENDS_CONFIG_INIT (engine_dispatcher.cpp:52-59), making the in-process version gate a self-check. HandshakeAck carries protocol_version and engine_version=LEGENDS_API_VERSION (main.cpp:55-57) but the proxy validates only error_code (proxy_connection.cpp:41-43); IpcError::VersionMismatch mapping (ipc_error_mapping.h:21) is dead code. The app's resolved .conf path (application.cpp:893) never reaches the engine host in IPC mode.
findings.recommendation: Validate ack.protocol_version/engine_version in ProxyConnection::connect (fail with VersionMismatch); add api_version+struct_size to CreateReq with host-side validation; transmit config_path/working_dir subject to the roadmap's path-confinement checks.

findings.title: IPC responses are not correlated by message type or sequence ID; timeout permanently desynchronizes the protocol stream
findings.evidence: ProxyConnection::request<Resp>() deserializes msg->payload without checking msg->header.msg_type == Resp::type or matching sequence_id (proxy_connection.h:42-44); send_and_recv assigns a fresh seq but never verifies it on receive (proxy_connection.cpp:80-87). After a 5s timeout the late response remains queued and the next request consumes it; field-wise LE decoding silently reinterprets the wrong struct as valid data. The header already carries both correlation fields (message_header.h:17-20).
findings.recommendation: Check msg_type (with ErrorResponse special-cased) and discard responses with stale sequence_ids in request<>; drain the channel on timeout before reuse.

findings.title: Installed package is broken for embedders: forwarding headers reference never-installed aibox headers, runtime_host.h has no installed implementation, IPC artifacts not installed
findings.evidence: install(DIRECTORY include/legends include/pal ...) (CMakeLists.txt:1350) ships all 25 forwarding headers each doing #include <aibox/...> (e.g. builder.h:3) while engine/include/aibox is never installed; gsl.hpp ships publicly despite self-documenting 'Do NOT include this header in public API headers' (it requires the PRIVATE gsl-lite dep); runtime_host.h is installed but its implementation src/app/runtime_host.cpp is compiled only into the never-installed legends_app target; include/legends_ipc and legends_proxy/legends_engine_host artifacts are not installed. Only legends_embed.h + legends_export.h survive installation intact.
findings.recommendation: Define and install only the supported public surface (C ABI headers, plus runtime_host.h if its impl moves to an installed library), or install aibox headers alongside; add a CI consumption test that cmake --installs and builds a minimal external embedder via find_package(Legends).

findings.title: RuntimeHost facade: InProcessEngineRuntime and IpcEngineRuntime are byte-identical ~300-line duplicates; public header implemented in the app layer; dead FrameData type; facade covers only 32/50 APIs
findings.evidence: Both subclasses forward every method to the same legends_* symbols with identical bodies (runtime_host.cpp:25-318 vs 328-621); the real backend switch is link-time (legends_proxy vs legends_core), so the class split encodes a difference that does not exist. The header lives in public include/legends but is implemented in src/app and compiled into GPL-linked legends_app. legends::FrameData (runtime_host.h:25-33) is used by no interface method and duplicates legends_ipc::FrameData. 18 C APIs (get_emu_time, get_state_hash, verify_determinism, get_last_error, has_capability, register_event_callback, video capture trio, etc.) are absent from the facade, so code like crash autosave bypasses it with the raw handle (application.cpp:957).
findings.recommendation: Collapse to one concrete runtime class (or give IpcEngineRuntime real responsibilities: connect/heartbeat/crash-restart), move the implementation into an installable non-app library, delete legends::FrameData, and round out or document the facade subset.

findings.title: Module DAG enforcement lags the IPC split: license-critical edges for legends_proxy/legends_ipc/legends_engine_host declared but never verified; legends_app absent from manifest
findings.evidence: ModuleManifest.cmake:63-68 declares DAG edges for six modules, but legends_verify_all_dags() checks only legends_core/legends_pal/aibox_core (ModuleDAG.cmake:196-206) and legends_detect_cycles() hardcodes those same three (ModuleDAG.cmake:124). The MIT-only constraint on legends_proxy (no GPL deps) is therefore unenforced at configure time. legends_app, which links legends_core PUBLIC (CMakeLists.txt:571-575), has no manifest entry at all.
findings.recommendation: Extend both verification functions to all declared modules plus legends_app (data already exists in the manifest) and run DAG verification in CI for both monolithic and IPC configurations.

findings.title: legends_config_t evolution policy is self-contradictory: header promises additive v1.x fields but create rejects struct_size != sizeof exactly; semver never exercised as API grew 22 to 50 functions
findings.evidence: legends_embed.h:114 states 'frozen for v1.x. New fields added at end only', but legends_create rejects config->struct_size != sizeof(legends_config_t) with strict equality (legends_embed_api.cpp:829), so any appended field breaks all previously compiled embedders — additive evolution is impossible as specified. Meanwhile LEGENDS_API_VERSION is still 1.0.0 (header lines 45-47) despite the surface growing from 22 (Feb audit) to 50 functions, and CHANGELOG.md contains only [Unreleased].
findings.recommendation: Switch to ranged prefix semantics (accept struct_size between the v1.0 minimum and current sizeof, reading only declared fields) now while no external consumers exist; bump MINOR on additions; add an older-struct-prefix case to tests/unit/test_legends_abi.c.

findings.title: Single-instance design contradicts README's multi-instance embeddability motivation; IPC layer re-bakes the limitation (singleton ProxyConnection, single engine-host handle)
findings.evidence: README.md:17 motivates the project by criticizing emulators unsuitable 'where you need multiple instances', yet legends_embed.h:13 declares 'Single instance per process' and legends_create enforces it via atomic CAS returning ALREADY_CREATED (legends_embed_api.cpp:803-819). The IPC architecture could deliver N instances via one engine-host process each, but ProxyConnection is a hard singleton (proxy_connection.cpp:8-11) and the engine host holds a single static g_handle (engine_dispatcher.cpp:13).
findings.recommendation: Make an explicit product decision: either commit to multi-instance-via-N-host-processes (key ProxyConnection per handle; protocol needs no changes since the handle is implicit) or correct the README positioning. Decision is S; implementation if chosen is L.

findings.title: Dead/unsolicited protocol message types and an uninitialized-bytes leak in GetStateHash dispatch
findings.evidence: ForceDestroyReq, CaptureRgbReq/Resp, CaptureAudioReq/Resp, SetLogCallbackReq, video-capture, SetTtfFontReq, RegisterEventCallbackReq, and EventNotification IDs are never sent nor dispatched (proxy maps force_destroy to DestroyReq, proxy_api.cpp:85-87; capture paths use SHM); Handshake (0x0001) is never sent — the engine pushes an unsolicited HandshakeAck (main.cpp:54-62). GetStateHashReq handler serializes resp.hash even when legends_get_state_hash failed, leaking up to 32 uninitialized stack bytes across the process boundary (engine_dispatcher.cpp:177-182).
findings.recommendation: Zero-initialize response structs before serialization, annotate reserved/SHM-superseded message IDs, and implement EventNotification (needed for api-02 log/event parity) or remove it.

findings.title: SDL3 executable duplicates the entire ~45-file legends_app source list inline
findings.evidence: The SDL3 project_legends target re-lists every source already registered in legends_app (CMakeLists.txt:1211-1268 vs 503-556). New app sources must be added in two or three places (SDL2 lib, SDL3 inline, IPC variants), and drift produces backend-specific link failures of the kind already live in api-01.
findings.recommendation: Make legends_app PAL-agnostic and link it from both SDL targets, or factor the source list into a single CMake variable consumed by all targets.

findings.title: C1 header duplication resolved via forwarding headers (verified)
findings.evidence: All 25 overlapping pairs are now 4-7 line forwarding shims (#include <aibox/X.h>; namespace legends { using namespace aibox; }) with the canonical implementation solely in engine/include/aibox (diff comparison run across all pairs: legends side 4-7 lines vs aibox 59-746 lines). Residual caveat captured separately as api-05: the shims are installed while aibox headers are not.
findings.recommendation: Close C1. Track the install-time breakage under api-05; consider replacing blanket 'using namespace aibox' with explicit aliases to avoid namespace pollution.

findings.title: H5 destroy-fallback fixed in-process (verified); permissive behavior survives only in IPC proxy
findings.evidence: legends_destroy now returns LEGENDS_OK for null handles and LEGENDS_ERR_NULL_HANDLE for non-matching non-null handles via get_instance() pointer-equality check (legends_embed_api.cpp:960-969); the g_active_instance fallback is gone. The IPC proxy's handle-ignoring destroy (proxy_api.cpp:81-83) re-creates the spirit of H5 across the boundary — tracked under api-02.
findings.recommendation: Close H5 for the in-process path; fold the proxy-side equivalent into the api-02 parity work.

findings.title: L2 unused error codes now all used (verified)
findings.evidence: LEGENDS_ERR_REENTRANT_CALL returned from legends_reset and step paths (legends_embed_api.cpp:1010); LEGENDS_ERR_IO_FAILED used in IPC error mapping (ipc_error_mapping.h:15-16) and embed API; LEGENDS_ERR_NOT_SUPPORTED used by proxy stubs, dispatcher default case (engine_dispatcher.cpp:536), and stub APIs per commit 7f86dd7.
findings.recommendation: Close L2.

findings.title: L3 HandleRegistry still implemented but unused by the embed API
findings.evidence: HandleRegistry (504-line header) is consumed only by tests (test_handle_registry.cpp, test_thread_safety.cpp, test_gsl_contracts.cpp); the embed API validates handles by pointer equality against the single g_active_instance (legends_embed_api.cpp:79-82). The unused class is additionally re-exported publicly via the forwarding header.
findings.recommendation: Either adopt HandleRegistry as the multi-instance enabler (pairs with api-09) or delete it and its forwarding header to shrink the public surface.

findings.title: L4 LEGENDS_ERROR macro collision resolved (verified)
findings.evidence: Repo-wide grep finds exactly one definition of LEGENDS_ERROR (legends_embed_api.cpp:690, with defensive #ifdef/#undef at 687-688); neither include/legends/error.h (now a forwarding shim) nor engine/include/aibox/error.h defines it. Commit 91569c6 also documented the dual public-negative/internal-positive error-code systems with sign-invariant static_asserts in legends_embed.h:56-99.
findings.recommendation: Close L4.

sprint_recommendations: Make IPC mode real (api-01, api-03, api-04): wire EngineSpawner+connect bootstrap into proxy legends_create, validate handshake protocol/engine versions, correlate responses by type and sequence ID, fix the SDL2+IPC link by extracting Application from GPL-linked legends_app, and add a CI job that boots the app end-to-end in IPC mode.

One ABI, two runtimes parity (api-02, api-06, api-10): build a single C-ABI conformance suite run against both backends in CI; fix proxy null-handle/destroy(NULL)/capture_rgb contracts; collapse the duplicate RuntimeHost subclasses; implement EventNotification-based log/event forwarding or formally capability-gate the six NOT_SUPPORTED functions.

Installable SDK (api-05, api-08, api-11): prune the installed header set to the supported public surface, resolve the forwarding-header/aibox install mismatch, move runtime_host into an installed library, adopt ranged struct_size semantics before external consumers exist, and add a cmake --install + external-embedder consumption test to CI.

Boundary enforcement catch-up (api-07): extend ModuleDAG verification to all six declared modules plus legends_app so the MIT/GPL link constraints underpinning the licensing story are enforced at configure time in both build modes.

verdict.note: Verified all cited lines and adversarially searched for mitigations; finding holds on all three legs. (1) No bootstrap: ProxyConnection::connect (proxy_connection.cpp:13-51) is declared only in the private src/legends_proxy/proxy_connection.h and repo-wide grep shows its sole callers are unit tests; proxy_api.cpp gates every API including legends_create (lines 23/33/57) on is_connected() -> LEGENDS_ERR_NOT_INITIALIZED; no getenv/auto-connect anywhere in legends_proxy; CrashHandler::restart (crash_handler.cpp:35) spawns only on restart and is never started by the app; IpcEngineRuntime ctor (runtime_host.cpp:328) just stores the handle and is constructed after legends_create at application.cpp:905, so Application::init always returns EngineCreateFailed (application.cpp:917) in IPC builds. (2) Link failure: project_legends compiles only src/main.cpp (CMakeLists.txt:1152-1156) and in IPC mode links only legends_proxy+legends_pal (1173-1180); main.cpp:9 needs legends::Application defined only in legends_app (503-505); checked the escape hatch legends_configure_app_entrypoint_target (585-602) — it adds only include dirs/defines, no sources/libs; legends_app PUBLIC-links GPL legends_core (571-574) so it cannot be added without defeating isolation. CMake comment 439-442 confirms SDL2+IPC is the intended design, so this is incomplete implementation, not an unsupported combo; same flaw in the SDL3 block (1268, 1273-1280).
